wholePhysicalScope: Two mapped exterior outlines, the exact CC0 Qualla photos of the restored Operations and Carme pavilions, and original public elevation.
lodDetails: Four levels retain both pavilions, the tiled Operations gable, the Carme dome and water tower. Near levels add masonry arches, patterned tiles and glazing.
limitations: The model includes the restored Operations and Carme pavilions. The administrative building, other wards, landscaping and the underground galleries are outside its scope.
The exact photographs govern the principal elevations, roof finishes and ornament. Heights, backs of the buildings, roof subdivisions, figural sculptures and inscriptions are simplified or estimated.
The original public DEM establishes relative ground level. Foundation depths compensate for the approximated grades without modifying the elevation source.
